keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; its Maya envelope covers Copan to 849). 'The kingdom covered an area of over 250 square kilometers'; the valley is 476 km2 with a rural population of 3,000 to 4,000. Drawn as a 15 km radius, the smallest the 250 km2 grid shows; one keyframe for the whole life because the page gives no change of extent.

region.text: the kingdom of Copan: 'over 250 square kilometers', in the Copan Valley (476 km2)

ledger.note: 426: the Copan dynasty is founded. 'The refounding of Copan in AD 426' by K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' ('relating the founding of the dynasty in AD 426-427' on Altar Q); the page links the founder to Teotihuacan ('a general from the great metropolis of Teotihuacan') and says 'this coup was apparently organized and launched from Tikal'; afterwards Copan 'remained closely allied with Tikal'.
724: Quirigua is made Copan's vassal. Its king 'was installed as a vassal in 724 by Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil'.

April 738: Quirigua's king captures and beheads Copan's. 'In April 738 K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat captured Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil', who was beheaded at Quirigua; by 734 the Quirigua king was 'no longer an obedient subordinate'.

region.text: the kingdom of Copan: 'over 250 square kilometers', in the Copan Valley (476 km2)

ledger.note: 822: the last Copan king. Ukit Took', 'its last known king', 'came to the throne on 6 February 822'; the collapse of the city-state 'is believed to have occurred sometime between 800 and 830 AD' and 'was sudden' (Altar Q's reigns run 426 to 763 on the Classic Maya collapse page). The end year is the last accession, not a conquest.

wars.name: Copan-Quirigua war
wars.outcome: Quirigua rebelled against Copan: by 734 its king was 'no longer an obedient subordinate' and in April 738 he captured and beheaded Copan's king, ending Copan's overlordship.
wars.note: Calakmul 'likely' sent warriors against Copan in 738 and 'sponsored Quirigua's rebellion in order to weaken Tikal' (Calakmul page, not opened for this dossier).

certainty.note: The kingdom had no recorded frontier; the radius is the grid's minimum and the 250 km2 is the page's area, not a border.

sources.title: Copán
sources.note: Founding 426-427, Tikal and Teotihuacan links, Quirigua vassal 724 and revolt 738, Yax Pasaj 763, Ukit Took 822, kingdom 250 km2.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Copan row. Quirigua has no dossier (its king was installed in 724, revolted by 734, killed Copan's king in 738; its last king 'began his rule between 795 and 800' per the Classic Maya collapse page); a gap-filler should open the Quirigua page. The Quirigua vassal events use the page's wording only.
END. 822 is the last accession; Cliopatria's envelope drops Copan in 850. The collapse page gives the Copan population as 28,000 at its peak, 15,000 in 900 and under 1,000 in 1200; the Copan page itself says 'at least 20,000' for the kingdom, so the figures differ by page.
ALTAR Q. The page's Altar Q reign list (426 to 763) is the source for a ruler strip; not entered because only the founding, Uaxaclajuun Ub'aah K'awiil (695-738), Yax Pasaj (763 to after 810) and Ukit Took' (822) were read.
